npcs.name: Loveday Marsh
npcs.actionData: We get rain every afternoon. Give it an hour and it's gone.

npcs.name: Gate Watch
npcs.actionData: The jungle starts at the end of this road, and nothing out there cares about the port's rules.

npcs.name: Post Watch
npcs.actionData: We don't open the gate after sundown.

npcs.name: Captain Abel Rusk
npcs.actionData: We trade here with whoever comes down the river. Lately that's mostly crews running away from something.

npcs.name: Post Watch
npcs.actionData: Stay near the fire after dark. Whatever's out there doesn't like the light.

npcs.name: Juno Ashby
npcs.actionData: The river comes down from the east. The temple city is somewhere up there, and the closer you get, the quieter the jungle goes.
